name: Product Carbon Footprint
description: Product carbon footprint credential aligned with the WBCSD PACT Tech Spec v2 (PCF Data Exchange).
summary: Credential type template for ProductCarbonFootprint, aligned with the WBCSD PACT Tech Spec v2 (PCF Data Exchange). Format jwt_vc_vcdm against the IDunion pcf schema, with a PDF twin, draft-first authoring and self-issuance enabled. The subject form has six groups: Product, Carbon Footprint, Biogenic & Land Use, Methodology, Assurance and Data Quality Indicators, covering the full PACT claim set. Issued by the IDTL PCF Participant wallet template.
